title: Protect academia in Sudan with global action | Science
content: Sudan’s civil war, which erupted in April 2023, has devastated the country’s universities. More than 10 million Sudanese people have been displaced, including tens of thousands of university staff and students (1). Although the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) has declared an education emergency in Sudan (2), the destruction of the country’s intellectual capital has drawn scant global attention. Sudan’s academic collapse is not just a regional tragedy—it is a global emergency that calls for urgent international action.
